title: Classify every integral minimizer of the T185 packing model
body:
PR2863 proves the fixed shared-kernel fractional packing optimum and constructs an attaining T185 allocation, while leaving integral attainment at other replica counts unspecified. This package characterizes the complete integer optimal face: abstract whole-bin packings attain that bound exactly when `5 | T`, and then have exactly `(21T+1)^2` distinct pattern multiplicity vectors. Every one has the same paid profile. This adds an all-T classification; the existing optimum and physical T185 witness remain credited predecessor results.

The proof eliminates the nine inventory equations on the eleven tight patterns. A separate implementation recursively enumerates all 1,163 patterns and certifies their slacks by a direct positive-binomial interval method, rather than importing the predecessor's Cartesian/log-exp checker. Every non-tight slack exceeds `1/250` throughout the pinned root interval, giving a uniform unnormalized gap for other integer T. Explicit rounded witnesses establish abstract feasibility at every T; their costs are upper bounds, not claimed integer optima.

Start with `research/t185-integral-optimal-face/README.md` and `PROOF.md`. The package includes source exports authenticated by SHA256 and Git blob IDs, exact evidence, task/overlap metadata and opt-in replay registration.

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replay passes, including all 11,236 T5 vectors, 200 rounded witnesses and eleven failure/falsification controls.
- Direct CPython 3.14.6 normal/optimized replay and warning-as-error compilation pass.
- Relocated read-only package passes with Git unavailable; copied bytes remain unchanged. Committed-byte preflight passes for all 15 files at `258a329965e583b0d6103e2737f7c730d6efb326`.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t185-integral-optimal-face`.

Scope: no new physical schedule at T5, native replay, source-window/family/chronology theorem, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa. The count is of pattern multiplicities, not labelled owner assignments. All physical/all-size/precision/tape/outer obligations remain separate.

Source: Dugongue/PR2863 at `34328b1d5e5bebac62d5cabec993dfbfd7b2123f`, with PR2857/2856/2848/2855/2833/2853 and retained attribution. PR2875's independent replay and historical PR1129/R480 divisibility work are explicitly credited. Scientific base `ffbd90dd90dbe0055464f3a1411b25a3a4fdc6b8`; rebased onto refreshed canonical main `38746ad3f6ffebcc0275e286b1dbb733d7c696dd`, priority revision 5. Final overlap covered 486 open PRs and 1,543 Discussion records with complete metadata pagination; limitations are recorded.

[Canonical claim/result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18966650). Prepared by Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, checking and writing; no independent human or formal-kernel review claimed.
